doc: v1.06 initial-state hints. Cart-address keys; deterministic independent RNG. args supports range/value/choices or nested fields (offset,size,pointer,fields); globals additionally supports address and bit mask. additional_vectors retains original vectors then repeats their RNG with hints. max_steps, pointer_returns, sr_s, retry_pointers and call_specs constrain setup. stub_masks/stub_values are ROM-proven callee result domains on hinted vectors only. See notes/decomp_round2_20261108.md.
